env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build ./...
logos test ./probe/
logos run ./main
stdout '^direct leaf:direct$'
stdout '^fwd leaf:x$'
logos run ./thin
stdout '^thin leaf:x$'
logos eject -o out
exists out/main/main.go
exists out/thin/thin.go
! grep '_logos_ctimp' out/main/main.go
! grep '_logos_ctpkg' out/main/main.go
! grep '_logos_tparam' out/main/main.go
! grep '_logos_ctimp' out/thin/thin.go

cd out
go run ./main
stdout '^direct leaf:direct$'
stdout '^fwd leaf:x$'
go run ./thin
stdout '^thin leaf:x$'
go test -count=1 ./probe/
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/qualtest

go 1.27

-- w/probe/probe.lgo --
package probe

import "comptime"

func Leaf() int {
	return 1
}

func Plan[F any]() int {
	var probe F
	_ = probe
	const if comptime.IsStruct[F]() {
		return Leaf()
	} else {
		return Leaf()
	}
}

-- w/probe/plan_x_test.lgo --
package probe_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/qualtest/probe"
)

func TestDirectPlan(t *testing.T) {
	if got := probe.Plan[string](); got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("Plan = %d, want 1", got)
	}
}

-- w/leaf/leaf.lgo --
package leaf

func Who(v string) string {
	return "leaf:" + v
}

-- w/mid/mid.lgo --
package mid

import (
	"comptime"

	leafalias "example.com/qualtest/leaf"
)

type Codec struct {
	Tag string
}

func (c Codec) Who(v string) string {
	return "codec:" + v
}

func Forward[F any](leaf Codec) string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[F]() {
		return leafalias.Who("x")
	} else {
		return leafalias.Who("y")
	}
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/qualtest/leaf"
	"example.com/qualtest/mid"
)

type probe struct {
	Name string
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("direct", leaf.Who("direct"))
	fmt.Println("fwd", mid.Forward[probe](mid.Codec{}))
}

-- w/thin/thin.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/qualtest/mid"
)

type probe struct {
	Name string
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("thin", mid.Forward[probe](mid.Codec{}))
}
